# PRD-REL-01

**Has rollback of this release been tested, and is the point after which rollback becomes recovery known?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Production entry lens](production.md) 0.1.1 |
| Area | REL: Release and recovery |
| Default severity | blocker |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `operations.deployment.rollback`, `operations.transition.point_of_no_return`, `evidence.type` |

## Rule

operations.deployment.rollback is set; evidence has a rollback-test for this version with outcome passed; operations.transition.point_of_no_return is set when there is a data migration.

## Sources

- DORA, capabilities and metrics (`dora`)
- Google, Site Reliability Engineering, chapter 32, The Evolving SRE Engagement Model (the Production Readiness Review) (`sre-prr`)
